Overview of Neuchatel Region (Neuchâtel)

Neuchatel Region (Neuchâtel) is located in the Neuchatel region of Switzerland, with its prefectural capital at Neuchâtel. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Historic Altstadt / Old Town, Panoramic mountain & lake views, Marked SwitzerlandMobility hiking trails, Local heritage museum.

RegionNeuchatel
Capital cityNeuchâtel
Cities & municipalities11
Primary transport hubNeuchâtel Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)

How to get to Neuchatel Region

Connected via hourly SBB CFF FFS rail and PostBus services; fully covered by the Swiss Travel Pass. Use our SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Neuchatel

When visiting cities across Neuchatel, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Cheese fondue
  • Raclette
  • Rösti
  • Bircher muesli
  • Swiss artisanal chocolate

Best time to visit Neuchatel

Best time to visit Neuchatel: Jun–Sep (summer trails), Dec–Mar (winter sports).
